newsitem.title: SPAIN: BoS buying pesetas at 85.00 per mark-dealers.
newsitem.headline: BoS buying pesetas at 85.00 per mark-dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Spain was buying pesetas at 85.00 per mark, dealers said on Monday.
Earlier this morning the central bank was reported to have bought pesetas at around 84.95 per mark.
"The Bank of Spain held off from intervening at around 84.95 per mark. But then the market pushed the peseta quickly to around 85.00 where the central bank started intervening again," a dealer said.
At around 1350 GMT the peseta was trading at 84.98/5.00.
The Bank of Spain declined to comment, in line with its usual policy.
The central bank, which cut its key money rate by 25 basis points to 5.75 percent last week, was also seen buying pesetas in the market on Friday.
